title: Degraded checkout
description: Synthetic monitor: orders-api p95 latency reached 919ms (normally ~129ms) and error rate peaked at 1.5%.
root_cause_detail: Per-request session objects in orders-api were retained by a global registry, so memory grew with traffic.
expected_symptoms: orders-api memory_usage climbs gradually from ~41% to ~100% over ~56+ minutes
increasing GC / heap pressure logs on orders-api
orders-api p95 latency rises from ~129ms to ~919ms as memory grows
orders-api errors appear late, error rate up to ~1.5%
orders-api db_connection_utilization stays within normal range
1 OOM kill / restart event(s) with memory drop and error spike
resolution: Restarted the pods, removed the global registry reference and added a heap usage alert.
